notes: Native hardware scenarios verify furnace fuels and blocked container returns, standard hopper insertion/extraction, partial burn and physical item transfer, upgrade performance and fuel efficiency, battery removal protection, persistent tiled monitor feeds and compact wooden/iron door seals.

Graphical tests exercise real upgrade/fuel inventory packets, Advanced return, embedded/fullscreen camera views, scanner destination selection, automatic dock/door-walk/return/undock, station core rename/access, survival crafting and travel, and beacon delivery/launch/return.
Public station visitors can operate safe ordinary doors and retain a return route after access revocation. Station berth configuration remains builder-only.
The pad advisory expiry/reload test has its own environment to isolate fixed tick assertions from concurrent registry writers.
Two-process multiplayer and the fresh-process crash matrix were not rerun for this update; native multiplayer/consent and transfer/recovery tests passed.
All game tests used disposable build worlds. No player survival save was opened or modified.
Fuel and module performance values are initial playtest tuning.
